cards.primary.background.absent: the kit has no card component; teaser and block-content carry their own surfaces

cards.primary.borderRadius.absent: no card component in the kit

cards.primary.padding.absent: no card component in the kit

cards.primary.titleColor.absent: no card component in the kit

layout.mobile.sectionPaddingY.absent: mobile page frames use the desktop section rhythm; read per block from the responsive frames

normalizations.why: Inter is served from Google Fonts; Lexia is a licensed Dalton Maag face not available to the build, Roboto Slab is the open slab-serif stand-in (named assumption)
Figma line heights are pixel values; CSS keeps them as computed px

motifs: AstraZeneca One AZ: magenta core (#830051, #d0006f), gold accent (#f0ab00), mineral greys (#ebefee, #9db0ac); flat surfaces, 4px radii
